title: Bruck Setu
text:
About me


My name is Bruck Setu. and I am currently a student at Middlebury College. My research interests include:

Unsupervised and Supervised algorithms
Sports Data
Reaction Efficiency using Catalysts
Time Series
Bayesian computation

When not working on projects in R or in lab, I am probably playing strategic games or planning my next trip.





Entering Hersheypark in Hershey, PA.









Education

Bachelor of Arts in Statistics, Middlebruy College , May 2026

Adviser: Dr. Alex Lyford

Bachelor of Arts in Molecular Biology & Biochemistry, Middlebury College, May 2026

Adviser: Dr. Bob Cluss




Contact
To reach me, please contact me at bruck.setu@gmail.com.

title: Bruck Setu
text:
Photocatalytic Demethylation of Dimethylbenzylamine in Oxygen-Free Conditions
Link to poster
Over the course of two semesters my partner Natalie and I worked to improve the mechanism of demethylating Dimethylbenzylamine which degraded under normal oxygen-free conditions.







Bayesian Case Study: Authorship of Federalist Papers
Link to Case Study
Applying Bayesian methods to help approach the problem of attributing authorship of the 12 disputed Federalist papers.










Position Flexibility in Premier League
Link to Report
Applying both unsupervised and supervised algorithms to determine whether Premier League players show statistical affinities for positions other than the ones they currently play.







Forecasting UFO Sightings
Link to Report
For the final report in Time Series Analysis my group decided to forecast Unidentified Flying Object sightings using Holt-Winters and ARIMA.







Using K-Nearest Neighbors to Predict Height of NBA Draftees
Link to Report
Building my own K-Nearest Neighbors function to be able to predict the height of a draftee using weight, draft year, and position played with some nifty 3D plots.










Exploring a Countries Pharmaceutical Spending in relation to GDP
Link to Report
Introductory data science report where data visualization and data wrangling were the primary focus.
